description: Na₃CoO₂ is Pb(Zr_(1-x)Ti_x)O3-like structured and crystallizes in the tetragonal P4₂/mnm space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a linear geometry to two equivalent O atoms. Both Na-O bond lengths are 2.31 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted see-saw-like geometry to four equivalent O atoms. There are three shorter (2.37 Å) and one longer (2.46 Å) Na-O bond length. Co is bonded in a linear geometry to two equivalent O atoms. Both Co-O bond lengths are 1.77 Å. O is bonded to five Na and one Co atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₅Co octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 4-18°.
